hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash mkdir ${STUDY_ID} cd ${STUDY_ID} conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-2b115560-c8c4-4cec-8418-537a35f9c192' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` database_psql_host_address='recoverdb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com'
dbname="${STUDY_ABV,,}_${VERSION,,}" #dbname="${STUDY_ABV,,}" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --username="$conn_user" --dbname="${dbname}" --csv -Atc \ "select json_agg(meta) from metadata_output.metadata meta" -o ${STUDY_ID}_${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt aws s3 cp ${STUDY_ID}_${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${STUDY_ABV,,}/decoded_data/ aws s3 cp ${STUDY_ID}_${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${STUDY_ID}/metadata/ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt aws s3 cp merged/${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${STUDY_ABV,,}/decoded_data/ # Sub-type the clinical data
if [[ "${STUDY_ABV,,}" == "recover_adult" ]]; then aws s3 cp "merged/${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json" \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${STUDY_ID}/metadata/${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.clinical.json" else aws s3 cp "merged/${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json" \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${STUDY_ID}/metadata/${STUDY_ABV,,}_metadata.json" fi unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
